markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (61%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (38%) is in the 90% conformal set [F1], with superior and lateral margins flagged [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 61%, Invasive 38%, InSitu 1%, Normal 0% | Split benign vs invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign, Invasive} (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 32nd OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical input, unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 InSitu (87%–89% similarity) [F5] | Mixed Benign and InSitu neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest invasive push (+1.42) [F2]; 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Benign push (-0.82) [F3]; unreliable (0/20 AI spot-check) · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Invasive push (+0.31) [F4]; 18/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Unreliable normal-lobule scores (0/20) in regions 9–11 mask focal invasive carcinoma in high-risk regions 0–3 and 7.
- True class is InSitu, matching 3/5 nearest neighbors (top match BACH_0117, 89% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Check for stromal invasion, pleomorphism, and superior margin involvement (645 um).
2. **Regions 3, 7**: Check lateral margin involvement (215 um) and region 7 (82% risk) for invasion.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Verify benign tubules and lobules directly, given the unreliable normal-lobule score (0/20).
